description: This file is a shell script designed to test handling of inter-pack delta cycles during git repack operations. It sets up test cases involving packs with delta objects, executes commands to create these packs, and verifies the integrity of the resulting packs to ensure no internal errors or cycles occur.

methods.name: make_pack
methods.description: Creates a git pack with specified objects, arranging deltas to test cycle handling in pack-objects.
